## First-Session Checklist

- [ ] Read `docs.AI/1_README.AI.md` — project mission and key facts
- [ ] Read `docs.AI/2_ARCHITECTURE.AI.md` — understand the plugin system
- [ ] Read `docs.AI/6_GLOSSARY.AI.md` — learn domain terminology before writing anything
- [ ] Read `docs.AI/9_WORKFLOWS.AI.md` — know the Golden Path before suggesting steps
- [ ] Check `specs/.templates/` — list files and ask user which templates are active this session
- [ ] Check `specs/feature.json` — identify the active feature directory (if any)
- [ ] Check `CLAUDE.md` — read tracker config, custom rules, and active iteration

---

## Context to Establish Before Taking Action

1. **What tracker is configured?** (ADO, Jira, GitHub, Linear, Notion, or none)
2. **Is there an active feature?** (`specs/feature.json` → active path)
3. **Which templates are active?** (files in `specs/.templates/`)
4. **Does a constitution exist?** (`specs/memory/constitution.md`)
5. **What step of the Golden Path are we on?** (does `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md` exist in the active feature dir?)

---

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

| Mistake | Correct Behavior |
|---------|-----------------|
| Skipping grill-me | Always start with `/ai-radija-grill-me` for any new feature |
| Writing tests after code | TDD: write the failing test FIRST (RED), then code (GREEN) |
| Horizontal task slices ("implement all DB first") | Always vertical: DB → logic → API → UI in one task |
| Using project templates without asking which are active | Ask at session start which `specs/.templates/` files apply |
| Hard-deleting records | Radija: always soft delete (`deleted_at` field) |
| Storing secrets in code or CLAUDE.md | Always vault (Azure Key Vault / Secrets Manager) |
| Writing code comments that explain WHAT | Only write comments for non-obvious WHY |

## Skill Trigger Quick Reference

| User says... | Invoke |
|-------------|--------|
| "new feature", "I want to build..." | `/ai-radija-grill-me` then `/ai-radija-specify` |
| "validate my approach", "does this make sense" | `/ai-radija-grill-me` |
| "create a spec", "write requirements" | `/ai-radija-specify` |
| "clarify the spec", "too many unknowns" | `/ai-radija-clarify` |
| "plan the implementation" | `/ai-radija-plan` |
| "break it into tasks" | `/ai-radija-tasks` |
| "implement it", "start coding" | `/ai-radija-tdd` then `/ai-radija-implement` |
| "create a PR", "ready to merge" | `/ai-radija-pr-ready` |
| "create tickets", "push to Jira/ADO/GitHub" | `/ai-radija-tasks-to-issues` or tracker-specific skill |
| "check quality", "validate requirements" | `/ai-radija-checklist` |
| "set governance rules" | `/ai-radija-constitution` |

## Project-Specific Notes (C:\RadijaAITools)

- This IS the skill pack itself — you are inside the tool, not inside a project that uses the tool
- There are no runtime application files to run or test
- Development work here = adding/modifying skills in `skills/ai-radija-*/SKILL.md`
- When modifying skills, preserve the YAML frontmatter format and test by invoking the skill
- Stack-bootstrap rules (`ai-radija-bootstrap`) apply only to projects bootstrapped via that skill, not to this repo itself
